questions.stem:
Let \(p(x)=x^3+ax+(b+2)\). Division by \((x-1)^2\) gives remainder \(2x+b\), and division by \(x-1\) gives remainder 6.

(a) Find \(a,b\).

(b) Find the quotient on division by \((x-1)^2\).

(c)(i) Factorise \(p(x)\). (ii) Find the H.C.F. of \(p(x)\) and \(x^2-x-6\).
questions.solution:
(a) At 1, \(2+b=6\), so \(b=4\). Also \(p(1)=1+a+b+2=6\), giving \(a=-1\).

(b) \[\begin{gathered}p=(x-1)^2(x+2)\\{}+2x+4\end{gathered}\], so quotient \(x+2\).

(c)(i) \(p=(x+2)(x^2-2x+3)\). (ii) \[\begin{gathered}x^2-x-6\\{}=(x+2)(x-3)\end{gathered}\]. The quadratic factor of \(p\) has no real roots, so the HCF is \(x+2\).
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 代入1得 \(2+b=6\)，故 \(b=4\)。又 \(p(1)=1+a+b+2=6\)，得 \(a=-1\)。

(b) \[\begin{gathered}p=(x-1)^2(x+2)\\{}+2x+4\end{gathered}\]，商式為 \(x+2\)。

(c)(i) \(p=(x+2)(x^2-2x+3)\)。(ii) \[\begin{gathered}x^2-x-6\\{}=(x+2)(x-3)\end{gathered}\]，而 \(p\) 的二次因式無實根，故最大公因式為 \(x+2\)。
questions.source: S4/more about polynomials/POLYNOMIALS SPCC REVIEW.pdf · Q5
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/POLYNOMIALS SPCC REVIEW.pdf · 第5題

questions.stem:
Let \(f(x)\) be cubic, divisible by \(2x^2+7x+9\). Its remainders on division by \(x+1\) and \(x-2\) are \(-16\) and \(-31\).

(a) Find the quotient on division by \(2x^2+7x+9\).

(b) Let \(g(x)=-4x^2+11x+3\). Someone claims all roots of \(f(x)=g(x)\) are rational. Do you agree? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
設 \(f(x)\) 為三次多項式，可被 \(2x^2+7x+9\) 整除，被 \(x+1\) 及 \(x-2\) 除時餘式分別為 \(-16\) 及 \(-31\)。

(a) 求被 \(2x^2+7x+9\) 除時的商式。

(b) 設 \(g(x)=-4x^2+11x+3\)。有人聲稱 \(f(x)=g(x)\) 的所有根都是有理數。你是否同意？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) Write \[\begin{gathered}f=(Ax+B)\\{}\cdot (2x^2+7x+9)\end{gathered}\]. At \(-1\), \(4(-A+B)=-16\); at 2, \(31(2A+B)=-31\). Hence \[\begin{gathered}-A+B=-4,\\2A+B=-1\end{gathered}\], giving \(A=1,B=-3\). Quotient \(x-3\).

(b) \[\begin{gathered}f-g=(x-3)\\{}\cdot (2x^2+11x+10)\end{gathered}\]. Its roots are 3 and \((-11\pm\sqrt{41})/4\). Since 41 is not a square, two roots are irrational. Disagree.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 設 \[\begin{gathered}f=(Ax+B)\\{}\cdot (2x^2+7x+9)\end{gathered}\]。代入 \(-1\) 得 \(4(-A+B)=-16\)；代入2得 \(31(2A+B)=-31\)。所以 \[\begin{gathered}-A+B=-4,\\2A+B=-1\end{gathered}\]，解得 \(A=1,B=-3\)，商式為 \(x-3\)。

(b) \[\begin{gathered}f-g=(x-3)\\{}\cdot (2x^2+11x+10)\end{gathered}\]，根為3及 \((-11\pm\sqrt{41})/4\)。41非完全平方數，故有兩個無理根，不同意。
questions.source: S4/more about polynomials/POLYNOMIALS SPCC REVIEW.pdf · Q6
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/POLYNOMIALS SPCC REVIEW.pdf · 第6題

questions.stem: The remainders when \(f(x),g(x)\) are divided by \(6-2x\) are 9 and 5. Find the remainder when \(f(x)-g(x)\) is divided by \(x-3\).

questions.stem:
\(f(x)\) is divisible by \(g(x)\), and \(g(x)\) is divisible by \(x-1\). Which must be true?

questions.stem: The remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(3x-2\) is \(R\). Find the remainder when \([f(x)]^2\) is divided by \(2-3x\).
questions.solution: Both divisors have root \(2/3\). Therefore the remainder is \([f(2/3)]^2=R^2\). Multiplying a divisor by \(-1\) does not negate the remainder.

questions.stem:
\(f(x+2)\) is divisible by \(x-1\). Which must be true?

I. \(x-3\) divides \(f(x)\). II. \(x+2\) divides \(f(x-1)\). III. The remainder of \(f(x+1)-x+1\) on division by \(x-2\) is \(-1\).
questions.solution: The condition gives \(f(3)=0\), proving I. At \(x=2\), \(f(3)-2+1=-1\), proving III. II would require \(f(-3)=0\), not guaranteed; for example \(f(t)=t-3\).
questions.solutionZh: 條件給 \(f(3)=0\)，故I正確。代入 \(x=2\) 得 \(f(3)-2+1=-1\)，故III正確。II須有 \(f(-3)=0\)，並無保證，例如 \(f(t)=t-3\) 就不成立。

questions.stem: Which polynomial does not have \(x+2\) as a factor?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪個多項式沒有因式 \(x+2\)？
questions.solution: Substituting \(x=-2\) gives the values 0, 0, 0 and 26 respectively. Only the fourth polynomial has a nonzero remainder.
questions.solutionZh: 代入 \(x=-2\)，四項的值依次為 0、0、0 和 26。只有第四項的餘式不為零。
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/Polynomials LWMSS.pdf · 第12題

questions.stem: If \(x+2\) divides the polynomial \(f(x)\), which factor must divide \(f(2x+1)\)?
questions.stemZh: 已知多項式 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x+2\) 整除，哪一項必為 \(f(2x+1)\) 的因式？
questions.solution: Substitute \(2x+1\) into the factor \(x+2\). This gives \(2x+3\).
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/Polynomials LWMSS.pdf · 第13題

questions.stem: Let \(p,q,r\) be constants. Which cannot be the remainder when \(x^3+px^2+qx+r\) is divided by \(x^2+1\)?
questions.stemZh: 設 \(p,q,r\) 為常數。用 \(x^2+1\) 除 \(x^3+px^2+qx+r\) 時，哪一項不可能是餘式？
questions.solution: The remainder is \((q-1)x+r-p\). It has no quadratic term.
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/Polynomials LWMSS.pdf · 第14題

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)=x^3-3x+k\). If \((x+1)^2\) divides \(f(x)\), find \(k\).
questions.solution: Set \(f(-1)=0\). Then \(-1+3+k=0\), giving \(k=-2\). Indeed the cubic is \((x+1)^2(x-2)\).
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/Polynomials LWMSS.pdf · 第15題

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)=k^2x^2+5kx+8\) and \[\begin{gathered}g(x)=x^2-2(k-5)x\\{}+6k\end{gathered}\]. They have equal remainders on division by \(x+2\). Find the values of \(k\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \(f(x)=k^2x^2+5kx+8\) 及 \[\begin{gathered}g(x)=x^2-2(k-5)x\\{}+6k\end{gathered}\]。兩式被 \(x+2\) 除所得的餘式相等，求 \(k\) 的值。
questions.solution: At \(x=-2\), subtract the two values. The difference is \(4k^2-20k+24\). Thus \((k-2)(k-3)=0\).
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/Polynomials LWMSS.pdf · 第16題

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)=ax^2+bx+c\). It leaves remainder 4 on division by \(x-1\) and is divisible by \(x+1\). Find \(a+c\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \(f(x)=ax^2+bx+c\)。已知 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x-1\) 除所得餘式為 4，且可被 \(x+1\) 整除。求 \(a+c\)。
questions.solution: Add \(f(1)=4\) and \(f(-1)=0\). The linear terms cancel, leaving \(2(a+c)=4\).
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/Polynomials LWMSS.pdf · 第17題

questions.stem:
Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=3x^3\\{}+4x^2-5x-k\end{gathered}\] for constant \(k\). If \(x+2\) divides \(f(x)\), which statements are true?

I. \(k=2\). II. \(3x+1\) is a factor. III. Division by \(x-2\) leaves remainder 28.
questions.stemZh:
設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=3x^3\\{}+4x^2-5x-k\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(k\) 為常數。若 \(x+2\) 是因式，下列哪些陳述正確？

I. \(k=2\)。II. \(3x+1\) 是因式。III. 被 \(x-2\) 除所得餘式為 28。
questions.solution: From \(f(-2)=0\), obtain \(k=2\). Then \(f(-1/3)=0\) and \(f(2)=28\), proving II and III as well.
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/Polynomials LWMSS.pdf · 第18題
